editorial:
Imagine a world where nothing is as it seems and everyone has a secret goal. You follow Suzuki, a teacher who loses everything and dives into the scary world of crime just to get revenge. Along the way, you meet Kujira, a creepy hitman who tricks people into killing themselves, and Semi, a cold killer who loves his knife. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel like you are walking into a trap right along with the characters. It is a wild ride where the lines between the good guys and bad guys get blurred very quickly.

What really makes this work is the acting, especially the way the characters switch their personalities. The action is sharp and the plot twists will keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the story feel a bit rushed, the energy never drops. If you love dark crime stories with a lot of mind games, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to see all the gritty details in high definition.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Suzuki was never just a victim. He actually planned everything to manipulate the killers and get his revenge. In the end, the different plot lines crash together in a violent showdown. Suzuki manages to outsmart Kujira and Semi, proving he is the most dangerous person in the room. He gets his payback, and the movie ends with the realization that he became just as cold as the criminals he hunted.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and revenge stories with big twists.
